name: ship
description: Prepare for production launch: deploy, monitor, rollback plan. Uses shipping-and-launch skill.

steps.prompt: Run the pre-launch checklist: code readiness, infrastructure readiness, monitoring readiness, communication readiness
Verify all CI/CD quality gates pass: lint, type-check, tests, coverage, build, security scan, accessibility check
Execute staged rollout plan: canary (5%, 10min) → quarter (25%, 30min) → half (50%, 1hr) → full (100%)
Monitor metrics after each stage: error rate, P95 latency, business metrics. Rollback if thresholds exceeded
Draft launch communication using the template in shipping-and-launch skill
